original_ai_output.title_zh: 奥贡州社区呼吁州长保护祖传土地
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州Obafemi Owode地方政府区Orile-Mo的Fere和Oniporogun社区居民向州长Dapo Abiodun请愿，要求阻止据称将土地分配给中国投资者的做法。居民于周六在争议地点举行抗议，称推土机和安保人员已被部署到已有住宅和财产的土地上开始作业。居民要求州政府停止相关活动并召开紧急会议协商解决。

location.site: Orile-Mo, Obafemi Owode Local Government Area
location.raw_text: Fere and Oniporogun communities in Orile-Mo, Obafemi Owode Local Government Area of Ogun State

key_facts.fact: 奥贡州Fere和Oniporogun社区居民向州长请愿，要求保护祖传土地
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Residents of Fere and Oniporogun communities in Orile-Mo, Obafemi Owode Local Government Area of Ogun State, have appealed to Governor Dapo Abiodun to intervene in an alleged land allocation to Chinese investors

key_facts.fact: 居民于周六在争议地点举行抗议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The residents made the appeal during a protest on Saturday at the disputed site

key_facts.fact: 居民称推土机和安保人员已被部署到该土地开始作业
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: alleging that bulldozers and security personnel had been deployed to commence operations on land where homes and other properties had already been developed

key_facts.fact: 居民称该开发可能导致数百个家庭无家可归
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: noting that the development could render hundreds of families homeless and destroy their ancestral heritage

uncertainties: 土地分配给中国投资者的说法为居民指控，尚未获得独立证实
推土机和安保人员部署情况为居民单方面说法
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，缺乏交叉验证
